title: Unit-integral top-degree test form supported in a nonempty open set
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let U and W be arbitrary subsets of ℝⁿ such that W is open, W ≠ ∅ and W ⊆ U (U need not be open). Then there is a test form ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) such that spt ω ⊆ W and ∫_{ℝⁿ} ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) dLⁿ(x) = 1. Here ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) means ω is a C^∞ map from ℝⁿ to the n-covectors (continuous alternating n-linear forms) of ℝⁿ with compact support and spt ω ⊆ U; e_1,…,e_n is the standard basis of ℝⁿ and Lⁿ is Lebesgue measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsOpen W → W.Nonempty → W ⊆ U → ∃ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ W ∧ ∫ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume = 1
